description: Which properties each user TYPE may carry, measured against a real account for all three types: FIRST_NAME / MIDDLE_NAME / LAST_NAME are refused on both service types; PASSWORD and MUST_CHANGE_PASSWORD are refused on SERVICE but KEPT by LEGACY_SERVICE (that is the point of the type); EMAIL / DISPLAY_NAME / DEFAULT_WAREHOUSE / COMMENT are carried by every type; and a PERSON carries everything. The refusal is the same sentence at CREATE and at ALTER, naming the type it applies to. Converted 1:1 from features/ServiceUserPropertyTest (now retired). Users are account-level, so each test drops the users it creates.
